label: Kimi K3.1 Pro
output:
To: ashbourne-terrace-chimney
Replying to: [p05]
Cc: none
Subject: none

Mick, please do not go into no. 43 at 9, either to install props or to inspect the loft. Priya, please don’t drop a key over for this. An acrow prop does not make it safe to enter. Standing beneath a holed roof with a loose chimney stack above is about the worst place to put people. Debris may already be loading the floors, and nobody currently knows how the remaining loads are being carried. Propping without that assessment could transfer load somewhere else and make matters worse.

I’m a structural engineer, chartered with IStructE, but this is not a commission and I have no PI cover for free advice. I’m speaking only as a neighbour who looked from the opposite pavement at 7.05.

No. 41 still has roughly 1.2m of stack standing, leaning towards 43. The pots have gone and mortar at the base looks washed out. The Met Office is forecasting 50mph gusts again this afternoon. At 43, the front roof slope has a roughly 2–3m² hole. There is a 5–10mm stepped crack from the bay head up to the first-floor window cill, and the bay head appears to have dropped around 20mm.

JoJo, your cousin is right that Victorian terraces can be robust generally, but this one has been damaged. That is a different situation and it needs proper assessment.

Priya, I would not use the pavement. There are loose slates at the gutter lines of 43 and 45 directly above it. Please walk on the other side until the council has inspected and made the area safe, especially children on the St Dunstan’s school run. The council already knows, but only 43’s front garden is taped, not the footway. Out of hours, dangerous structures is contacted through the main council number.

Mrs Doherty’s decision is not mine, and I cannot declare 45 safe from outside. I couldn’t see the 43/45 party wall. Its front looks undamaged, and the remaining stack is on the 41/43 party wall, not 45. Even so, I would not sleep in 45’s front room tonight. It would be much better for her to stay with family until 45 has been checked.
